card.name: Leading digit of hundreds in doses
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the zero after it) of a three- or four-digit number ending in 00, such as 500 mg or 800 mg, in dose-increment and dose-table text. It fires before the model writes the remaining zeros.

modes.label: Dose increment amounts
modes.description: A leading digit in a stated maximum or step increase of a daily dose, such as 500 mg per 4 weeks.
modes.example: Daily dose should not be increased more than <<5>>00 mg in a 4-week

modes.label: Dose or threshold values
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a hundreds-level dose or lab cutoff in tables or interaction text.

card.writes: It suppresses hundred and thousand words and promotes ten words, which fits a number that continues with zeros.
card.plain: It marks the start of round dose numbers like 500 or 800 mg, as the number is still being written.
